declienting: Ported the imperative showBanner(messageHtml, { variant, dismissMs, className }) utility to a declarative React <Alert>; the messageHtml innerHTML sink became a children: ReactNode slot, which removes the XSS surface, and the caller owns visibility through open.

Dropped the className override hook: its only caller-specific use was the mini-cart's add-to-cart-banner styling, a commerce coupling (the mini-cart was Rejected as commerce). Presentation is expressed through variant instead.

Dropped the imperative fixed-position insertion into a client banner container; the library Alert is an in-flow block whose top-of-page placement is the caller's, because page-level positioning is a client-page concern.
Replaced the inline SVG icon markup with an inline currentColor tone icon per variant; the library ships no Icon component yet.

Mapped banner.css surface/text classes onto library semantic tokens: the surface to color-surface-raised, text to color-text-primary, and the positive/critical variants to color-tone-positive / color-tone-critical — new status tokens added to src/tokens/semantic.css, since the library had no tone layer; plus border color-border-subtle, box radius-medium, and rhythm spacing-m / spacing-s.

Kept verbatim: the icon + message + dismiss layout, the role/aria-live pairing per variant (positive → status/polite, critical → alert/assertive), and the auto-dismiss timing — the live-region contract. Kept deliberately distinct from Toast rather than merged.
